method.label: Verify the formula and bound the sum

annotationRationale: Induction verifies the formula suggested by the recurrence. A telescoping comparison bounds the reciprocal-square remainder tightly enough to determine the floor.
sourceMethod: Followed the official method of recognizing and verifying the explicit formula, expanding the sum of squares, and bounding the remaining sum by a telescoping comparison. Made the induction step explicit.

review.mathCheck: Induction correctly gives a_n=n+1/n. Squaring yields 338,550+r, where r is the reciprocal-square sum. The comparison telescopes to 1<r<2−1/100<2, so the requested floor is 338,551, choice B. Both strict endpoints are justified.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 21, page 14: identify and verify the explicit formula, separate the square sum, and bound the remainder by telescoping. The candidate makes the induction and cancellation explicit.
review.annotationCheck: All four selected concepts occur in the explanation. Induction appropriately supports formula verification; the sum-of-squares formula is explicitly supplied as background. No material gap remains.
